controller: Identical core.MPC objective, 30-step preview, 10 ms sampling, ±800 N; objective normalization remains 500 N to keep physical effort penalty unchanged; rebuild with each changed prior-sample estimate, no rounding or smoothing.
causality: Measure acceleration after current action, update mass for next step. Only oracle receives current true mass; no future mass schedule in prediction.
primary: Group reduction = 100*(mean fixed RMS - mean adaptive RMS)/mean fixed RMS over 4–20 s; also individual-road counts and early/late windows.
selection: No tuning or selecting by adaptive improvement. Plot upper-median fixed MPC loaded RMS at 200 kg, sinusoidal roads.
